title: Step from a running configuration
statement: Let $R$ be the number of work tapes, let $\Lambda$ be a finite set of labels, let $P$ assign an instruction to each label, let $x$ be an input bit string, and let $\ell_0 \in \Lambda$. For any compiled control state $q$, valid input-head position $p$, work tapes $T_i : \mathbb{Z} \to \{0,1,\sqcup\}$, work-head positions $h_i \in \mathbb{Z}$, and output string $w$, a configuration with control state $q$ takes one machine step to the result of applying the compiled transition action determined by $q$, the symbol under the input head, and the symbols under the work-tape heads.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position among the $|x|+2$ valid positions
Work tapes and their head positions
replaced:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite set of labels, $P$ a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in
$\Lambda$, $\ell_0 \in \Lambda$, and $x$ an input bit string. Let $C$ be a configuration on input
$x$ of the machine of $P$ started at $\ell_0$ which is in some control state $q$ (not halted),
with work tapes $(T_i)$ and work heads $(h_i)$. Then one step of that machine maps $C$ to the
result of applying to $C$ the action that the compiled transition table of $P$ assigns to $q$,
the symbol under the input head of $C$, and the work-tape symbols $(T_i(h_i))_i$.
